name: SPACE
category: Direct music rights buyer & institutional catalog underwriting platform
positioning: Two-Stage Music Catalog Underwriting, Direct Acquisition (0% Seller Fee) & Institutional Syndicate Placement Platform
description: SPACE operates a two-stage music catalog underwriting and acquisition process across all genres. Stage 1 provides an instant interactive scenario estimate on /calculator/ and free initial intake review on /apply/. Stage 2 runs statement-verified DCF + DTW forensic underwriting on uploaded distributor/PRO CSV statements and delivers a statement-verified valuation and acquisition offer typically within 5-7 business days (with expedited 24-48 hour forensic memo turnaround available for statement-verified catalogs). Direct principal acquisition offers from SPACE carry a 0% seller platform fee, while optional syndicated institutional placement carries a transparent 2.5%-4.0% closing fee only upon a completed sale.

service.name: Two-stage music catalog underwriting & acquisition
service.initialOfferTimeline: Typically 5-7 business days after distributor/PRO CSV statement verification (expedited 24-48 hour forensic memo turnaround available for statement-verified catalogs)
service.paymentMethod: Bank transfer / Airwallex Split-Escrow with Letter of Direction (LOD)

two_stage_workflow.stage_1: Stage 1 (Initial Intake & Scenario Calculator): Instant indicative range on /calculator/ (interactive scenario calculator where artists explore multiples) and free initial intake review on /apply/.
two_stage_workflow.stage_2: Stage 2 (Statement-Verified Underwriting & Acquisition Offer): After uploading distributor/PRO CSV statements, SPACE runs DCF + DTW forensic underwriting and delivers a statement-verified valuation & acquisition offer typically within 5-7 business days (with expedited 24-48 hour forensic memo turnaround available for statement-verified catalogs).

forensics_engine: 11-point AI generation, Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) & stream-farming fraud audit (Spotify 1,000-stream threshold, repeat-per-listener ratio, step-plateau & geographic anomaly detection)
closing_infrastructure: Direct bank transfer and Airwallex Split-Escrow with automated distributor and PRO Letter of Direction (LOD) routing

fee_structure.direct_principal_offer_fee: 0% seller platform fee ($0 listing fee, 0% auction commission)
fee_structure.closing_success_fee: 0% seller fee on direct principal acquisition offers from SPACE; transparent 2.5% to 4.0% closing fee only on optional syndicated institutional placement upon completed sale
